summary_en: Approved acquisition of up to 134,000 shares (0.53% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥260 million through November 6, 2026 to March 31, 2027 via ToSTNeT-3 and market purchases to enhance capital efficiency and enable flexible capital policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Meikoukensen Co., Ltd. announced on November 5, 2026 that its board of directors approved the acquisition of up to 134,000 shares of common stock for a maximum of ¥260 million. The buyback program will run from November 6, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The shares represent 0.53% of the 25,242,966 issued shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026.

The company will acquire shares through two methods: off-floor trading via ToSTNeT-3 and open market purchases on the Nagoya Stock Exchange. The authorization does not specify an upper price limit per share. The company stated that the buyback aims to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions.
